title: Handwriting (Theme 3: Etiquette)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 English; not yet checked by a Kenyan English teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child checks each letter: feet on the floor, tails under it, start at the margin.

floor.question: Which letter has a tail: y or n?

steps: Show the line as the floor.

board.do: Point at the part to look at.
board.say: Which letters are not on the floor?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer.
The child writes or fixes it.
Show the right version beside it.

misconceptions.ask: Is it standing on the line?

listen_for: a line that rises to the right
y sitting on the line with its tail up
misconceptions.ask: Which way does the tail go?

checks.question: Where does the first word go?
Which part of g goes below the line?
